title: Acquire and recover a fleet's last observed facts
description: Four ordinary authenticated commanders admit through the UI. One forms a real fleet; another acquires and recovers last-seen intelligence while owner forces remain private. Catalogue/domain clocks and scan entropy identities are explicit harness controls, never injected reports. Development scanning and force rules remain under review; hosted scheduling, secure-provider and production entropy certification are separate gates.
